command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp LC_ALL=C
cd /tmp
python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' > cpu-probe.txt 2>&1
import ctypes, glob, re, platform
def line(k, v): print(f"{k:28s} {v}")
line("uname_machine", platform.machine())
# The decisive value: OpenBLAS is built DYNAMIC_ARCH, so it re-selects kernels per HOST
# at load time. If the trajectory grouping follows this string rather than the image
# digest, kernel selection is the mechanism.
so = sorted(glob.glob("/opt/conda/lib/libopenblas*.so*"))
lib = ctypes.CDLL(so[-1])
for fn in ("openblas_get_corename", "openblas_get_config"):
    f = getattr(lib, fn); f.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
    line(fn, f().decode())
line("openblas_so", so[-1].split("/")[-1])
txt = open("/proc/cpuinfo").read()
feat = re.search(r"^Features\s*:\s*(.*)$", txt, re.M)
feats = set(feat.group(1).split()) if feat else set()
line("has_sve", "sve" in feats)
line("has_sve2", "sve2" in feats)
line("has_asimd", "asimd" in feats)
impl = re.search(r"CPU implementer\s*:\s*(\S+)", txt)
part = re.search(r"CPU part\s*:\s*(\S+)", txt)
line("cpu_implementer_part", f"{impl.group(1) if impl else '?'} / {part.group(1) if part else '?'}")
try:
    line("sve_vector_length_B", open("/proc/sys/abi/sve_default_vector_length").read().strip())
except OSError:
    line("sve_vector_length_B", "n/a (no SVE)")
PYEOF
cat cpu-probe.txt
echo "PROBE OK"
